column1: # Reviewed semantic identities for GAME audio initialization, VAB loading, and sequence lifecycle control.
# Every row was checked with kf sema addr/disasm --blocks/xref/xref --callees/strings, CFG JSON,
# current reconstruction state, callers, adjacent boundaries, history, Psy-Q Release 2.5 LIBSND.H,
# and the pinned Psy-Q FID/vendor inventories.

column6: 3 CFG blocks; straight-line Psy-Q setup followed by a ten-halfword initialization loop
column7: sole caller is game_main_loop initialization; configures tick, master volume and studio-C reverb, allocates audio_sequence_buffer, supplies the 344-byte audio_sequence_table, clears audio_sequence_active, and initializes audio_voice_ids
column8: no live arguments or result; every operation is shared-state initialization
column9: absent from vendored/FID inventories; body orchestrates identified LIBSND calls rather than implementing them
column12: supported; SsInit and SsSetTableSize identities are corroborated by their header signatures and position in the surrounding SSINIT call chain, not promoted as exact FIDs here

column6: 6 CFG blocks; stop-existing-sequence prelude plus header/body failure branches
column7: resource caller passes the first payload at record+4 and the second payload after the first length; calls the VAB-head entry, SsVabTransBody and SsVabTransCompleted, and writes audio_vab_header/audio_active_vab_id
column8: a0 and a1 are preserved as byte pointers and passed to the Psy-Q VAB APIs; no result escapes
column9: absent from vendored/FID inventories; error strings and API orchestration are game-owned
column12: supported; the retained retail typo in the header failure string is not normalized

column6: 4 CFG blocks; stack path construction, music guard, load failure tail, and play path
column7: callers select sequence 0, 1, or 2; copies audio_sequence_path_template, patches map bank at byte one and sequence at byte six, loads audio_sequence_buffer, obtains audio_sequence_id, sets volume 75, plays, and sets audio_sequence_active
column8: a0 contributes only its low byte plus ASCII zero to one path character; no result escapes
column9: absent from vendored/FID inventories; body orchestrates file loading and identified LIBSND calls
column12: supported; exact map-bank field owner remains unresolved

column6: 4 CFG blocks; active guard, 76-step sequence-volume loop, stop/close tail
column7: five callers use it before VAB/sequence replacement and when the settings menu disables music; waits one vertical sync per step, calls SsSeqSetVol on audio_sequence_id, then stop/close and clears audio_sequence_active
column9: absent from vendored/FID inventories; body is game fade policy around SDK sequence calls
column12: supported; anonymous stop/close targets are identified from LIBSND.H signatures and sequence lifecycle, not exact FIDs

column6: 5 CFG blocks; active guard, fixed-point master-volume loop, and stop/close tail
column7: sole caller is game_main_loop shutdown with fade step 0x80; decrements 0x4b00, writes symmetric SsSetMVol values, zeros sequence volume, stops/closes audio_sequence_id, and clears audio_sequence_active
column8: a0 is retained and subtracted at full 32-bit width; no result escapes
column9: absent from vendored/FID inventories; body is game fade policy around SDK sequence calls
